changes: Recovered original draft and expanded distinct microtopics to required depth.
Verified official syllabus screenshots and landmark indexed records, including the 172-specimen study; added Ki-67 qualification and linked source anchors.
Clarified population balance, cell-fate retention, tissue feedback, ancestry vs function, necessity/sufficiency and model limitations; recalculated worked and assessment results.
Corrected schematic boundary, graph labels and scientific terminology.
Added 44 questions to existing eight; rewrote original ambiguous Part C item; checked 20/20/12 split and balanced keys.
Added seven original accessible figures, two comparison tables, five worked examples, thirteen misconceptions and sixteen active-recall prompts.
Renumbered figures and cross-references; aligned question/table CSS classes with reader; checked saved HTML and compared adjacent chapters.
Editorial review distinguishes recurring central concepts from repeated passages; lexical maximum Jaccard 0.1882, not proof of semantic originality.

rationale: Approved microtopics mapped and covered within introductory scope.
Science checked against authoritative references; not all full primary papers accessed (-1).
13,392 substantive words and comparable paragraph count; lower end of allowed narrative range and purposeful recurrence of population concepts (-1).
Eight worked examples and evidence interpretation; hypothetical datasets and condensed historical experiments (-1).
52 original explained items including 20 analytical; no external exam calibration (-1).
Static HTML, controls and links verified; no interactive browser/mobile/device or comprehensive accessibility test (-1).

limitations: Internal editorial review only; not external peer review.
MP SET current official-host version not independently verified; archived 2024 copy inspected.
Selected source abstracts and authoritative textbooks/reviews used; not all full texts read.
No interactive browser, mobile or assistive technology test. HTML structural and static source checks only.
No external question calibration or formal semantic originality assessment. Pages deployment verification is separate.
